animal-man-reading-order.text: Buddy Baker is the Animal Man, the chosen protector of The Red; the force which connects all animal life. He can mimic the abilities of any animal as a result of his encounter with a crashed alien spacecraft.

azrael-reading-order.text: Azrael is a vigilante who formerly operated out of Gotham City. Most of his extraordinary abilities come from severe amounts of subconscious training and conditioning he was put through during his youth. Named after the Angel of Death, Jean-Paul Valley is actually descended from a long line of crimefighters using the Azrael suit and name.

bane-reading-order.text: Bane is a super-intelligent world-class fighter and tactical genius who enhances his great physical strength with a steroid called Venom, making him one of Batman’s greatest and most dangerous enemies. He is one of the only men ever to independently figure out Batman’s secret identity.

barbara-gordon-reading-order.text: Barbara Gordon is the Gotham City vigilante known as Batgirl and elite computer hacker known as Oracle. She is the daughter of Commissioner James Gordon. After a period of time as Batgirl, she was shot in the spine by the Joker. Paralyzed from the waist down and looking for other ways to fight crime, Barbara became a hacker and information broker, donning the Oracle identity and founding the Birds of Prey.

batman-beyond-reading-order.text: In 2039 Bruce Wayne is now a man in his 70s, living in isolation in Wayne Manor. Terry McGinnis is an athletic 16-year-old high school student and reformed juvenile delinquent with a deeply ingrained sense of personal justice. After stealing the Batsuit, Bruce initially opposes all of Terry's efforts and demands that he return the suit, but Terry convinces Bruce to let him take on the Batman mantle.

batman-villains-reading-order.text: Batman’s rogues gallery has been widely well received, considered by many to be one of the greatest superhero rogues galleries in all of comics. This order includes villains who don’t warrant their own reading order.

batwoman-reading-order.text: Kate Kane is a wealthy heiress who becomes inspired by the notorious superhero Batman and chooses, like him, to put her wealth and resources towards a war on crime as a masked vigilante in her home of Gotham City.

big-barda-reading-order.text: Big Barda is a powerful New God from Apokolips who fell in love with Mister Miracle and became a warrior for good. Although she was originally a member of the Female Furies, since leaving her home planet, she has joined the Justice League of America and the Birds of Prey.

bizarro-reading-order.text: Lex Luthor once acquired the designs for a Duplicator Ray and after modifying the device, Luthor intended on using it to create a super-strong clone of his nemesis, Superman. However, the duplication process failed, and resulted in the creation of an imperfect duplicate of Superman.

black-adam-reading-order.text: Black Adam is a corrupted, ancient Egyptian predecessor of Captain Marvel. When he says the magic word “Shazam”, he is transformed into a super-powered being possessing the same powers that Captain Marvel would later be granted; however, Black Adam is soon corrupted by the vastness of his powers.

black-canary-reading-order.text: Black Canary is a superhero vigilante who fights crime using martial arts and a sonic scream attack. She is one of the greatest fighters in the world, and also a strong tactical mind.

black-lightning-reading-order.text: Jefferson Pierce returned to his old neighborhood in the Suicide Slum section of Metropolis, with his wife Lynn Stewart and his daughter Anissa to become the principal of Garfield High School. Possessing the ability to manipulate and generate electricity, Pierce decided it was time to make a difference and adopted the costumed identity "Black Lightning".

blue-beetle-and-booster-gold-reading-ord.text: When Ted’s uncle made an attempt to take over the world, Ted set out to stop him, recruiting the help of his archaeology teacher Dan Garrett – the first Blue Beetle. In the course of the adventure, Dan was fatally wounded and asked Ted to carry on the legacy of the Blue Beetle. Booster Gold was born in the year 2442. Traveling back in time and using the technology he stole from the 25th Century, he became a superhero. He uses his knowledge of historical events and futuristic technology to stage high-publicity heroics.

brainiac-reading-order.text: Vril Dox, alias Brainiac, is a brilliant Coluan scientist. He acquired a spaceship and went on a journey through space, acquiring knowledge and using his robotic drones to capture living organisms of various alien species.

captain-cold-reading-order.text: Captain Cold, real name Leonard Snart, is one of the Flash’s most enduring foes and the calculating leader of the Rogues. Armed with his iconic cold gun Snart combines precision, caution, and a strict personal code that even other criminals respect.

cassandra-cain-reading-order.text: Cassandra Cain was the fourth Batgirl. Born with the assassins David Cain and Lady Shiva as her parents, she was trained to become the perfect warrior. Her father deprived her of speech so she would learn movement and physicality as her first language.

catwoman-reading-order.text: Selina Kyle is Catwoman, a costumed adventurer who’s been both super-hero and super-villain. Beginning her career as a thief and adversary to Batman, she later turned to crime-fighting.

cheetah-reading-order.text: Once archaeologist Dr. Barbara Ann Minerva, she was transformed through a cursed ritual tied to the god Urzkartaga, gaining superhuman speed, strength, senses, and near-immortality. Her claws can cut through most materials, and she moves with unmatched ferocity.

clayface-reading-order.text: Clayface is a shapeshifting monstrosity born from tragedy, able to mold his body into any form or weapon. Once human, now unstable, he drifts between villainy and fragile redemption, never fully in control.

cyborg-reading-order.text: Cyborg, aka Victor Stone, is a hero rebuilt through tragedy and transformed into one of the DC Universe’s most advanced tech-powered champions. Despite immense power, his greatest struggle is defining his humanity and proving it’s what makes him a hero.

cyborg-superman-reading-order.text: Cyborg Superman is a devastating fusion of human hatred and Kryptonian power. Once astronaut Hank Henshaw, he was reborn through corrupted technology after a catastrophic space accident destroyed his body and life. Blaming Superman for his suffering, Henshaw rebuilt himself using Kryptonian cybernetics, gaining strength, durability, and weapon systems rivaling the Man of Steel.

damian-wayne-reading-order.text: Damian Wayne is the son of Batman and Talia al Ghul. This makes him an heir to the world’s greatest crime-fighter, and its greatest super-villain Ra’s al Ghul. Damian became the fifth Robin, working alongside Dick Grayson as Batman.

darkseid-reading-order.text: Darkseid is the tyrannical ruler of Apokolips and one of the most feared beings in existence. A New God of immense power, he seeks the Anti-Life Equation to strip all free will from the universe and impose absolute order under his rule.

deadman-reading-order.text: Deadman, also known as Boston Brand, is a ghost. Murdered by an assassin, his spirit haunts the mortal realm bringing justice to those who deserve it. Although he cannot directly interact with the physical world, he can possess bodies of the living and control them towards his own ends.

deathstroke-reading-order.text: Slade Wilson là một cựu đại tá quân đội tinh nhuệ đã tình nguyện tham gia vào một cuộc thử nghiệm cường hóa quân sự. Thí nghiệm đã tăng cường tiềm năng não bộ của ông lên đến 90%, mang lại thể chất siêu nhân và khả năng tư duy chiến thuật vượt trội gấp nhiều lần người bình thường. Hoạt động dưới mật danh Deathstroke the Terminator, ông là tay lính đánh thuê và sát thủ nguy hiểm nhất thế giới, kẻ thù truyền kiếp của Teen Titans và Batman.

doctor-fate-reading-order.text: Kent Nelson is Doctor Fate, a powerful sorcerer and agent for the Lords of Order. His amulet, cloak and helmet are creations of the ancient Nabu, who acts as his mentor and spiritual guide.

doom-patrol-reading-order.text: The Doom Patrol are a team of heroes known as freaks, outcasts, and social misfits. They dedicate their lives to protecting the society that will not accept them. Their leader is a ruthless and manipulative genius known as The Chief.

duke-thomas-reading-order.text: Duke Thomas is a rising young hero in Gotham, known for his sharp mind, courage, and strong moral compass. Unlike other Robins, Duke forged his own path, becoming The Signal, a daytime protector of Gotham.

elongated-man-reading-order.text: Ralph Dibny was fascinated by contortionists. He learned that all of the body-benders he spoke with drank a popular soda called "Gingold." Ralph set to work learning chemistry and developed a super-concentrated extract of the rare "gingo" fruit of the Yucatan, which gave him his elasticity.

etrigan-the-demon-reading-order.text: Etrigan the Demon is a powerful, rhyming demon bound to the mortal Jason Blood by the wizard Merlin during the time of Camelot. Though often forced to fight for good, his demonic nature makes him unpredictable and ruthless, Jason struggles to control the beast within.

firestorm-reading-order.text: Firestorm is the nuclear-powered hero formed when two individuals, most famously Ronnie Raymond and physicist Martin Stein, merge into one being through a fusion accident. Possessing the Firestorm Matrix, he can rearrange matter at the atomic level.

green-arrow-reading-order.text: Green Arrow is a vigilante who fights crime using archery, technology, and martial arts. In his secret identity he is politician and billionaire Oliver Queen, a hot-headed social activist and owner of Queen Industries. The extended family of heroes who work with him call themselves Team Arrow.

guy-gardner-reading-order.text: Guy Gardner is one of the most brash and hot-headed members of the Green Lantern Corps. Chosen as a backup Green Lantern for Hal Jordan, he eventually earned a ring of his own, wielding the green light of willpower with fearless determination.

hawkman-and-hawkgirl-reading-order.text: Hawkman is a winged vigilante who fights crime using a flight harness made from Nth metal and a mace. His secret identity is Carter Hall, an archaeologist and museum curator who lives out his destiny as a reincarnation of the ancient Egyptian prince Khufu. Sheira Sanders is Hawkgirl, the reincarnation of Chay-Ara. She is married to Carter Hall aka Hawkman.

huntress-reading-order.text: Helena Bertinelli, once the daughter of a powerful mafia family, became Huntress after surviving their brutal murder, dedicating her life to dismantling organized crime. Trained in stealth, archery, and hand-to-hand combat, she’s a fierce operative who often walks the line between hero and avenger.

jim-gordon-reading-order.text: As the police commissioner of Gotham City, Gordon shares Batman's deep commitment to ridding the city of crime. He is a stalwart ally of Batman, and the father of Barbara Gordon.

jimmy-olsen-reading-order.text: Jimmy Olsen is an investigative reporter and photo-journalist, formerly a copy-boy, working at the Daily Planet since his teenage years. His closest friends and co-workers are Clark Kent, Lois Lane, and Perry White.

joker-reading-order.text: The Joker là "Hoàng tử Hề Tội Phạm" (Clown Prince of Crime), kẻ thù truyền kiếp vĩ đại và nguy hiểm nhất của Batman. Danh tính và nguồn gốc thực sự của hắn vẫn chìm trong bí ẩn, ngoài chi tiết hắn rơi vào một bồn chứa hóa chất khiến làn da bị tẩy trắng, tóc chuyển sang màu xanh lá và tâm trí bị đẩy vào trạng thái điên loạn tột cùng. Joker coi tội ác như một trò đùa nghệ thuật, tôn thờ sự hỗn loạn và không ngừng tìm cách chứng minh rằng bất kỳ ai cũng có thể trở nên điên loạn chỉ sau "một ngày tồi tệ".

justice-league-dark-reading-order.text: Justice League Dark is a mystical branch of the Justice League, formed to combat supernatural threats beyond the reach of traditional heroes. Operating in the shadows and often bending the rules, Justice League Dark handles the occult battles that the main League can’t, protecting the world from mystical horrors that most don’t even know exist.

justice-league-reading-order.text: Justice League of America (JLA) là liên minh siêu anh hùng vĩ đại nhất của Vũ trụ DC, tập hợp những người bảo vệ hùng mạnh nhất của Trái Đất (Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, The Flash, Green Lantern, Aquaman, Martian Manhunter). Hoạt động từ Tháp canh Watchtower ngoài quỹ đạo Trái Đất, Justice League là tuyến phòng thủ đầu tiên và kiên cố nhất của nhân loại trước những hiểm họa mang quy mô hủy diệt toàn vũ trụ.

justice-society-reading-order.text: The Justice Society of America was founded in 1940 after several superheroes saved the life of President Franklin Roosevelt. Eight of the world’s greatest heroes all banded together to stop Adolf Hitler’s invasion of Britain.

killer-croc-reading-order.text: Killer Croc is a tragic and terrifying figure in Gotham’s underworld. Afflicted with a rare genetic condition that gives him reptilian skin, enhanced strength, and aquatic abilities. Whether in the sewers or among the Suicide Squad, Croc is a dangerous but sometimes misunderstood force of nature.

king-shark-reading-order.text: King Shark is a humanoid shark and the son of the Shark God. Possessing superhuman strength, durability, and razor-sharp teeth, he is both a fearsome predator and a formidable foe. Torn between his animal instincts and his attempts to find a place among humans, King Shark straddles the line between villain and reluctant antihero.

krypto-reading-order.text: Krypto the Superdog is Superman’s pet, a Kryptonian creature with incredible powers and the appearance of a dog. Growing up alongside Superboy, he was raised in Smallville on the Kent Farm, although he later lives in Metropolis with Clark Kent and Lois Lane.

larfleeze-reading-order.text: Larfleeze, aka Agent Orange, is the leader of the Orange Lantern Corps. He became owner of the orange light when he stole its Power Battery from the Guardians. The light’s power of avarice affected him, and he began obsessively hoarding things.

legion-of-super-heroes-reading-order.text: The Legion of Super-Heroes is a 30th Century intergalactic team of super-powered young adults. Inspired by the legend of Superboy, they were founded by Cosmic Boy, Lightning Lad, and Saturn Girl.

lex-luthor-reading-order.text: Lex Luthor is one of the most dangerously intelligent men on the planet; a supervillain, a brilliant scientist, a billionaire industrialist, and Superman’s greatest enemy. This makes him an extremely powerful and formidable opponent; he is ruthless, efficient, and creative.

lobo-reading-order.text: Lobo is an ultra-violent motorcycle-riding intergalactic bounty hunter. Born on the planet Czarnia, he killed every other member of his race for a high school science experiment and then gave himself an “A” on the assignment. In addition to incredible strength, he has an accelerated healing factor that will completely regenerate his entire body from even a single cell.

lois-lane-reading-order.text: Lois Lane is an investigative reporter at the Daily Planet in Metropolis, and Superman’s main love interest. She is a strong and assertive woman more than capable of handling herself in dangerous situations.

martian-manhunter-reading-order.text: Martian Manhunter, also known as J’onn J’onzz and John Jones, is from the planet Mars and the last surviving member of his race. A martian holocaust killed his wife and daughter, nearly driving him mad, until he was accidentally brought to Earth.

mary-marvel-reading-order.text: Mary Marvel is the twin sister of Captain Marvel and a member of the Marvel Family, given incredible powers by the wizard Shazam.

metal-men-reading-order.text: Doc Magnus invented the Responsometer, a device that animates robots and gives them sentience. This allows the Metal Men to morph into liquid shapes but retain their solid form. Each member is named after the element they are made from, and their personalities reference properties of those elements.

metallo-reading-order.text: Metallo is a radioactive cyborg intelligence who depends on Green Kryptonite as his energy source. He is a former soldier who was used in experimentation by the United States Army, eventually giving him the ability to project his consciousness into any technological device.

metamorpho-reading-order.text: Metamorpho, real name Rex Mason, is a hero transformed by exposure to a mystical artifact known as the Orb of Ra. Once an adventurous archaeologist, Rex’s body was altered into a living chemical element, giving him the ability to transmute parts of himself into virtually any element or compound on the periodic table.

mister-freeze-reading-order.text: Mister Freeze is a cryogenic scientist whose tragic obsession with saving his terminally ill wife, Nora, drove him into villainy. After an accident locked his body at sub-zero temperatures, Victor Fries must live within a refrigerated suit that grants him superhuman strength and immunity to cold.

mister-mxyzptlk-reading-order.text: Mister Mxyzptlk is a reality manipulating imp from the 5th Dimension who antagonizes Superman. Not actually evil, he does no long-term damage although he constantly seeks to pester and prove he’s smarter than the man of steel. He cannot be made to return to his home dimension until he’s tricked into saying his own name backwards “Kltpzyxm.”

new-gods-reading-order.text: The New Gods are natives of the twin planets of New Genesis and Apokolips. New Genesis is an idyllic planet filled with unspoiled forests, mountains, and rivers and is ruled by the benevolent Highfather, while Apokolips is a nightmarish, ruined dystopia filled with machinery and fire pits and is ruled by the tyrant Darkseid.

ocean-master-reading-order.text: Ocean Master is Aquaman’s ambitious and power-hungry half-brother. A skilled warrior and master tactician, Orm commands formidable sorcery and advanced Atlantean weaponry. Driven by resentment toward Arthur and a belief that Atlantis should dominate the surface world, he has repeatedly attempted to claim the throne for himself.

onomatopoeia-reading-order.text: Onomatopoeia is a mysterious serial killer who hunts non-powered vigilantes with chilling precision. His identity remains unknown, making him one of the most elusive and terrifying killers to ever haunt Gotham City's heroes.

parasite-reading-order.text: Parasite is an enemy of Superman who feeds on energy by hungrily absorbing it into his body, draining all living creatures into husks at his touch.

peacemaker-reading-order.text: Peacemaker is a heavily armed vigilante who claims he’ll achieve peace at any cost, no matter how violent the method. Christopher Smith, once a soldier and government operative, operates with military precision but an increasingly unstable moral compass.

penguin-reading-order.text: The Penguin is one of Gotham City’s most notorious crime lords. Born into a wealthy but shunned family, his short stature, hooked nose, and love of birds earned him ridicule, fueling his rise as a ruthless underworld figure. Though not physically imposing, his cunning, resources, and deadly trick umbrellas make him a constant thorn in Batman’s side and a kingpin of organized crime.

phantom-stranger-reading-order.text: The Phantom Stranger is a mysterious supernatural guide and specialist in the occult. His paranormal origins and even his true nature are largely unknown, although he has acted as an agent of the Lords of Order.

phantom-zone-reading-order.text: The Phantom Zone is an interdimensional realm outside the normal space/time continuum. It is a barren and insubstantial null area absent of any physical material. Krypton exiled the worst of the planet’s criminals into the zone, the most famous of which was General Zod.

plastic-man-reading-order.text: Plastic Man is a super-hero whose unique completely malleable body chemistry allows him to stretch to great lengths and contort himself into any position. Despite being one of the most powerful entities on the planet because of the limitless nature of his powers, he has a care-free and humorous attitude towards life, leading many to not take him seriously.

poison-ivy-reading-order.text: Poison Ivy is a brilliant botanist turned eco-terrorist with the power to control plant life and produce deadly toxins. Once a researcher betrayed and experimented on, she gained immunity to poisons and the ability to manipulate flora on a massive scale.

power-girl-reading-order.text: Power Girl is the Earth-Two equivalent of Supergirl, native Kryptonian and cousin to Superman. The distinctive costume she wears lacks an emblem, she uses this as an advantage to distract others in combat.

ragman-reading-order.text: Ragman is a Jewish vigilante in Gotham City who wears the mystical Suit of Souls. This costume allows him to take the souls of the guilty, and summon their strength or abilities in combat. Through his actions, their evil deeds are redeemed and they are slowly allowed to ascend to Heaven.

ras-al-ghul-reading-order.text: Ra’s al Ghul is the centuries-old leader of the League of Assassins, a master strategist, and one of Batman’s most formidable enemies. Sustained by the restorative Lazarus Pits, he possesses unparalleled knowledge of warfare, science, and global politics.

renee-montoya-reading-order.text: Renee Montoya is a detective working for the Gotham City Police Department who frequently allies herself with the vigilante Batman and his associates. Following the death of her mentor Vic Sage she takes on a costumed identity, becoming The Question.

reverse-flash-reading-order.text: Eobard Thawne, a scientist from the 25th century, replicated the Speed Force and became corrupted by his fixation on the Flash’s legacy. Twisted by envy and madness, he uses his Negative Speed Force to alter timelines, erase lives, and strike at Barry from moments he can’t predict.

scarecrow-reading-order.text: Dr. Jonathan Crane, once an expert in phobias, was dismissed from academia for unethical experiments and embraced his obsession fully. His signature fear toxin induces vivid, paralyzing hallucinations that break victims psychologically before he ever touches them.

shazam-captain-marvel-reading-order.text: The name Shazam originally belonged to an ancient wizard. This wizard bestowed powers on the child Billy Batson. Batson simply had to speak the wizard’s name, and he would transform into the adult Captain Marvel. Later on, Billy Batson began using the name Shazam as his alias instead of Captain Marvel.

sinestro-reading-order.text: Sinestro is a former Green Lantern who became the tyrannical leader of the Sinestro Corps. Once a respected Lantern, he was exiled for ruling his sector with an iron fist. Wielding a yellow power ring fueled by fear, Sinestro seeks to impose his vision of order through terror. A master strategist and one of Hal Jordan’s greatest foes, he believes true peace can only be achieved through control.

solomon-grundy-reading-order.text: Solomon Grundy is an immortal zombie supervillain from the 19th Century. Originally murdered in the mysterious Slaughter Swamp, he resurrects and regenerates there every time he is killed again in his zombie form.

stargirl-reading-order.text: Stargirl, real name Courtney Whitmore, is a bright and determined young hero who carries on the legacy of the Star-Spangled Kid and the Justice Society of America. Balancing school, family, and heroics, Stargirl embodies optimism, courage, and the spirit of a new generation.

stephanie-brown-reading-order.text: Stephanie Brown began her vigilante career under the guise of Spoiler. She was a frequent ally of Tim Drake. During his retirement, she briefly claimed his position and became Batman’s partner Robin. She later succeeded Cassandra Cain and became the newest Batgirl.

suicide-squad-reading-order.text: The Suicide Squad, a.k.a. Task Force X, is a team of imprisoned super-villains. They act as deniable, covert assets of the U.S. government, and undertake high-risk, black-ops missions in exchange for commuted prison sentences. Their commander is Amanda Waller, who runs the organization out of Belle Reve Penitentiary.

superboy-reading-order.text: Superboy is a younger version of Superman. This was originally the identity that Clark Kent adopted using his powers to help others as a teenager in Smallville.

supergirl-reading-order.text: Kara Zor-El is Superman’s cousin. When Krypton was attacked by Brainiac, he took Kandor with him, while Kara and her parents remained in Argo. When Brainiac came to consume Argo City, her parents had no choice but to send her in a rocket headed for Earth. However, her rocket was caught in a large kryptonite-encrusted meteor and she arrived on Earth years after her cousin did.

swamp-thing-reading-order.text: Swamp Thing is an elemental creature who shares a connection to all plant life on the planet Earth through a network called the Green. He is a mass of vegetable matter that absorbed the memories and personality of Alec Holland, a botanist who died in a swamp shortly after creating a hormonal Bio-Restorative Formula for plants.

the-creeper-reading-order.text: The Creeper is a street vigilante who fights crime with a dark and deranged appearance, using insanity to strike terror into the hearts of criminals. In his civilian identity he is television talk show host Jack Ryder, an outspoken Gotham City media personality.

the-question-reading-order.text: The Question is Vic Sage, vigilante protector of Hub City. He is a great martial artist and detective, an investigative reporter in his civilian identity. When Sage was dying of lung cancer, he trained Renee Montoya as his successor and she eventually replaced him.

the-riddler-reading-order.text: The Riddler commits crimes revolving around an obsession with riddles. His mental psychosis results from a deep inner need to prove that he’s smarter and therefore better than others, which causes him to leave challenging clues behind in otherwise perfect crimes.

the-rogues-reading-order.text: The Rogues are an unusually social group, maintaining a code of conduct as well as high standards for acceptance. They do not kill anyone unless it is absolutely necessary. This loose criminal association refer to themselves as the Rogues, disdaining the use of the term "supervillain" or "supercriminal".

the-spectre-reading-order.text: The Spectre is a cosmic entity and the physical embodiment of God’s vengeance on Earth. Permanently bonded to a human soul, he uses his incredible divine powers to punish the truly wicked.

the-titans-reading-order.text: The Titans are Earth’s premier team of young heroes, forged through friendship, trust, and shared legacy. Led by Nightwing, they stand united against threats too great for any one hero, proving that hope, teamwork, and compassion are as powerful as any superhuman ability.

tim-drake-reading-order.text: Tim Drake is a member of the Bat Family who has taken several names. Originally he became the third Robin when he figured out Bruce Wayne’s secret identity. Proving himself in combat, he was taken on for training, and would eventually become one of the world’s greatest detectives and martial artists. After Damian Wayne became the latest Robin, Drake assumed the identity of Red Robin.

two-face-reading-order.text: Two-Face is obsessed with duality and the number two. In his private life he was Harvey Dent, Gotham’s district attorney. His face was burned with a bottle of acid during a trial. His psychosis leads him to believe that right and wrong don’t matter, as everything is ruled by chance. To prove this he makes decisions of good or evil based on the flip of a special coin.

wally-west-reading-order.text: Wally West is a speedster, the original superhero known as Kid Flash and the third character known as The Flash. His mentor was the second Flash, Barry Allen, who took him on as a side-kick after accidentally duplicating an experiment that had given him powers.

wonder-woman-reading-order.text: Công chúa Diana của Themyscira là một nữ chiến binh Amazon bất tử được ban phước bởi các vị thần đỉnh Olympus cổ đại. Sinh ra trên hòn đảo Thiên Đường tách biệt với thế giới bên ngoài, Diana được chọn làm sứ giả hòa bình đại diện cho xứ sở Amazon đến với thế giới loài người. Khoác lên mình chiếc Thòng lọng Sự thật (Lasso of Truth) và Đôi vòng tay Bất hoại (Bracelets of Submission), Wonder Woman chiến đấu vì tình yêu, hòa bình và bình đẳng cho muôn loài.

zatanna-reading-order.text: Zatanna is one of the greatest magic-users in the DC Universe. Her father is the legendary magician Zatara and she works hard to live up to his legacy. The traditional method of spell-casting she uses involves speaking words and sentences backwards.
